name: Scouts 9"
summary: Scouts X: in the pre-battle step, a unit whose models all have this ability can deploy from Strategic Reserves wholly within your deployment zone, or make a scout move of up to X" (here 9") ending more than 8" horizontally from enemies.

name: Stealth
summary: If every model in a unit has Stealth, that unit has the benefit of cover against ranged attacks that target it.

name: Achillan Eye
summary: This model's radium jezzail attacks against Infantry units can re-roll the Wound roll; its Skatros transuranic arquebus attacks against Monster or Vehicle units can re-roll the Wound roll.

name: Adaptive Tactics
summary: Select one friendly Skitarii or Thulia Ghuld unit within 6" of this model: until your next Command phase, that unit remains eligible to shoot and to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

name: Aerial Deployment
summary: In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

name: Battle Protocols
summary: While this model leads a Kastelan Robots unit, it begins in Aegis Protocols; each Command phase it can switch to Protector Protocol (+2 ranged Attacks) or Conqueror Protocol (+2 melee Attacks) until changed again.

name: Blind Barrage
summary: After this unit shoots, select one hit enemy Infantry unit: until your next turn, while this unit remains on the battlefield, that enemy unit's attacks suffer -1 to their Hit roll.

name: Blistering Salvoes
summary: This model's belleros energy cannon attacks against Infantry units gain +1 to the Hit roll; its ferrumite cannon attacks against Monster or Vehicle units gain +1 to the Hit roll.

name: Bomb Rack
summary: At the end of your opponent's Fight phase, target one visible enemy unit (not Lone Operative) within 24" and roll six D6: for each 4+, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

name: Bound Creation
summary: While a Tech-Priest model leads this model's unit, that Tech-Priest model has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

name: Breaching Command
summary: Each attack a model in this unit makes can re-roll a Hit roll of 1, or re-roll the Hit roll entirely while this unit is within 6" of a friendly Adeptus Mechanicus Battleline unit.

name: Broad Spectrum Data-tether
summary: Each time this unit is targeted by a Stratagem, roll a D6: on a 5+ you gain 1CP.

name: Broad-spectrum Targeting Augurs
summary: Each attack a model in this unit makes with an eradication caster against a non-Monster, non-Vehicle unit gains the Sustained Hits 1 ability.

name: Canticles of the Omnissiah
summary: At the start of your Command phase, select one ability from this model's Canticles of the Omnissiah list; this model has that ability until your next Command phase.

name: Chaff Launcher
summary: The bearer gains the Smoke keyword.

name: Cogitative Instincts
summary: Enemy units set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be placed within 12" horizontally of this model.

name: Command Uplink
summary: Each time the bearer's unit is targeted by a Stratagem, roll a D6: on a 5+ you gain 1CP.

name: Control Edict
summary: While this model leads a unit, attacks made by models in that unit can have their Hit roll re-rolled.

name: Cybernetic Augmentation
summary: This model can move through terrain features (but not end its move inside one) and can be set up or end a move on any floor level of Ruins, provided its base does not overhang a non-ground floor.

name: Data-severed
summary: If this unit has no KASTELAN ROBOT models, it loses the Vehicle keyword and gains Infantry.

name: Data-spike
summary: At the start of the Fight phase, select one enemy Vehicle unit within Engagement Range of this model's unit and roll a D6: on a 4+ it suffers D6 mortal wounds and its melee weapons' Weapon Skill is worsened by 1 until the end of the phase.

name: Defend the Divine Work
summary: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, this model can give every model in its unit a 4+ invulnerable save until the end of that phase.

name: Dread Snipers
summary: After this model shoots, select one hit enemy unit: that unit must take a Battle-shock test.

name: Dynamic Efficiency
summary: This unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, and Desperate Escape tests taken for its models can be re-rolled.

name: Electro-infusion
summary: While a Character leads this unit, each attack that targets it has -1 applied to its Wound roll.

name: Electro-shock
summary: After this unit shoots, select one hit non-Monster, non-Vehicle enemy unit: until the end of the opponent's next turn, that unit has -2" Move and -2 to Advance and Charge rolls made for it.

name: Elevated Strider
summary: This unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back or Advanced, and Desperate Escape tests taken for its models can be re-rolled.

name: Emanatus Force Field (Aura)
summary: While a friendly Adeptus Mechanicus Battleline model is wholly within 6" of this model, it has a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

name: Enginseer
summary: While within 3" of a friendly Vehicle unit of the specified faction, this model has the Lone Operative ability; on one datasheet only while it is not leading a unit.

name: Enhanced data-tether
summary: Each time the bearer's unit is targeted by a Stratagem, roll a D6: on a 5+ you gain 1CP.

name: Fanatical Devotion
summary: Select one friendly Skitarii or Thulia Ghuld unit within 6" of this model: until your next Command phase, that unit remains eligible to shoot and to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

name: Focused Hunters
summary: At the start of the battle, select one enemy unit: for the rest of the battle, attacks a model in this unit makes against it can have their Hit roll re-rolled.

name: Galvanic Field
summary: While this model leads a unit, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the Lethal Hits ability.

name: Invocation of Machine Vengeance
summary: At the start of your Command phase, designate one enemy unit as your Machine Vengeance target until your next Command phase: attacks by friendly Adeptus Mechanicus models against it can have their Hit roll re-rolled.

name: Line-breakers
summary: When this unit ends a Charge move, roll a D6 per model within Engagement Range of a selected enemy unit (+2 if the charge started within 6" of a friendly Adeptus Mechanicus Battleline unit); each 4+ deals 1 mortal wound.

name: Lord of the Machine Cult
summary: While this model leads a unit, models in it have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability, or Feel No Pain 4+ instead if that unit has the Electro-Priests keyword.

name: Mantra of Discipline
summary: This model has the Battleline keyword. While a friendly Adeptus Mechanicus unit is within 6" of it, that unit's Objective Control is increased by 1 and it adds 1 to Battle-shock and Leadership tests.

name: Mechanicus Bodyguard
summary: While this model is within 3" of one or more other friendly Adeptus Mechanicus units, it has the Lone Operative ability.

name: Mindlock
summary: While a TECH-PRIEST model leads this model's unit, improve this model's weapons' Ballistic Skill and Weapon Skill by 1.

name: Monocular Targeting Helms
summary: Each attack a model in this unit makes with a neutron fusil against a Monster or Vehicle unit gains the Ignores Cover ability.

name: Network Override
summary: While this unit contains a Tech-Priest model, it is eligible to perform an Action in a turn in which it Advanced, and eligible to shoot in a turn in which it started an Action.

name: Neurostatic Interference (Aura)
summary: While an enemy unit is within 6" of this unit, its Battle-shock and Leadership tests suffer -1, or -2 instead while this unit is within 6" of a friendly Adeptus Mechanicus Battleline unit.

name: Objective Scouted
summary: At the end of your Command phase, if this unit is within range of an objective marker you control, you retain control of it, even without models in range, until the opponent controls it at the start or end of a turn.

name: Omnispex
summary: Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit have the Ignores Cover ability.

name: Omnissiah’s Blessing
summary: In your Command phase, select one friendly Adeptus Mechanicus model within 3" (once per phase): it regains up to D3 wounds, and if a Vehicle it also gains Feel No Pain 5+ until your next Command phase.

name: Optimised Gait
summary: Add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for this unit, or add 2 instead while it is within 6" of a friendly Adeptus Mechanicus Battleline unit.

name: Rad-saturation (Aura)
summary: While a non-Vehicle enemy unit is within 3" of this unit, its models have -1 to their Objective Control characteristic.

name: Repulsor Grid
summary: When an enemy unit shoots this unit, an unmodified 6 on a save roll deals that enemy unit 1 mortal wound after it finishes shooting.

name: Ride the Thermals
summary: After this unit shoots, if not within Engagement Range of any enemy unit, it can move up to 6" (or up to 12" if it ends wholly within 6" of a friendly Adeptus Mechanicus Battleline unit), but then cannot charge that turn.

name: Robotic Bodyguard
summary: While a Cybernetica Datasmith model leads this unit, that model has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

name: Rod of the War Forge
summary: In your Command phase, select one ability from this model's Icon of War list; this model has that ability until your next Command phase.

name: Scuttling Walker
summary: When this model makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move it can move through models and terrain features; how far that extends varies by datasheet, from friendly Monsters, Vehicles and terrain 4" or less in height to any non-Titanic model.

name: Searing Conflagration
summary: Phosphor torch attacks against an enemy unit within range of an objective marker can re-roll a Wound roll of 1, or re-roll it entirely while this unit is within 6" of a friendly Adeptus Mechanicus Battleline unit.

name: SECUTARII
summary: If a model with the Leader ability could be attached to a Skitarii Vanguard unit, it can be attached to this unit instead.

name: Secutor of Olympus
summary: At the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy Vehicle unit within 12" of this model and roll a D6: on a 2+ it suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.

name: Seekers of Divine Arcana
summary: While this model leads a unit, models in that unit have +1 to their Objective Control characteristic.

name: Self-repair Mechanisms
summary: At the start of your Command phase, this model regains up to D3 lost wounds.

name: Sentinel Directives
summary: When this unit is targeted with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, it scores hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+ instead of the normal threshold.

name: SERVITOR BODYGUARD
summary: At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, this model can join another unit led by a Tech-Priest Infantry model; for the rest of the battle it counts as part of that unit, increasing its Starting Strength accordingly.

name: SERVITOR RETINUE
summary: At the start of Declare Battle Formations, this unit can join one unit led by a Tech-Priest Enginseer (only one Servitors unit may join); its models then count as part of that Bodyguard unit, increasing its Starting Strength.

name: Servo-skull Uplink
summary: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, select one Battle-shocked friendly Skitarii unit within 6" of this model: it is no longer Battle-shocked.

name: Shroudpsalm (Aura)
summary: While a friendly Adeptus Mechanicus unit is within 6" of this model, that unit has the Stealth ability.

name: Strafing Run
summary: Each time this model attacks a non-FLY enemy unit with a ranged attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

name: SYDONIAN SENTINEL
summary: This model cannot be selected as your Warlord.

name: Tactica Obliqua
summary: Opponent's Movement phase: when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, this unit, if outside Engagement Range, can make a Normal move of up to D6", or of 6" ending wholly within 6" of friendly Adeptus Mechanicus Battleline.

name: Termite Assault
summary: This model must start in Reserves without counting against Reserves limits, and can arrive in the Reinforcements step of your first, second, or third Movement phase; embarked units then disembark more than 9" from enemy models.

name: The Fires of Mars
summary: Select one friendly Skitarii or Thulia Ghuld unit within 6" of this model: until your next Command phase, both the Conqueror Imperative and Protector Imperative are active for that unit.

name: Titan Guard
summary: This unit can be targeted with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem for 0CP, even if a different unit was already targeted this phase; if a friendly Adeptus Titanicus unit is on the battlefield, the resulting charge roll can be re-rolled.

name: Vengeance for the Omnissiah
summary: If a friendly Adeptus Mechanicus Vehicle model is destroyed within 12" of this model, its Omnissian axe gains an Attacks characteristic of 6 for the rest of the battle.

name: Voices in the Code
summary: At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of a unit with this ability must take a Battle-shock test.

name: Doctrina Imperatives
summary: Pick an Imperative each round. Protector: ranged Heavy, improved Ballistic Skill, -1 to enemy melee Hit rolls. Conqueror: ranged Assault, improved melee Weapon Skill, +1 Armour Penetration. Last effects need Battleline, or one within 6".
